reviews.conclusion: The +19.6167 s GUI-clock offset spans the last ~1.7 s of the run, its visible finish, End credits, and postfinish overworld play. Native frame inspection finds no visible prefinish cut or speedup, and the frozen final RTA matches the official 08:07.566 proof. This establishes finish/credits context, but does not localize or numerically explain the full GUI offset. No active-run splice or cheating is established.

Nether exit and return, eye measurement, nether traversal and stronghold entry are visible. Settings menus occur near proxy 12.75-14.25,18-19.25,76.25-77,82 and 82.75 s; a narrow rearranged game capture obscures pause state near 14.5-16.5 s. Menu durations can contribute substantially, but an exact -6.9 s accounting is unresolved.

Stronghold End portal entry is followed by a loading frame and settings menus retained from proxy 4.25 through 7 s. Their sampled duration is 2.75-3.25 s, with additional short loading transition. This is compatible with the -3.233 s deficit; native-frame exact closure is not established.
At Nether entry the options screen is held, followed by a brief return to options. Visible menu duration is approximately 2.5-3.5 s, compatible with the -2.95 s deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
